subject: On-demand audit export request and SLA / sampling plan (MedicoSys)
messages:
From: Security Team <security@medicosys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: on-demand audit export for SOC2 readiness (MedicoSys)

Hi Jordan,

We're preparing for an external SOC 2 readiness review and need a one-time export of admin activity and operator logs from Redwood for MedicoSys. Scope: May 1 2028 - Jul 31 2028.

Specific asks:
- Full admin activity stream (user/role changes, admin console actions)
- Operator trail and operator session metadata
- Auth events (token create/revoke) for service accounts tied to MedicoSys
- Exported manifest including sha256 checksums and a signed chain-of-custody statement

Preferred delivery: S3 presigned URL or secure transfer to our audit bucket (we can provide bucket + cross-account role). We need the export by EOD Aug 15 to meet audit timelines.

Attached: MedicoSys_Audit_Request_Form.pdf with contact and scope.

Contact for technical follow-up: Priya Rao (security@medicosys.com) and Audit Liaison (audits@medicosys.com).

Thanks,
Anoop Sharma
Security Team, MedicoSys
attachments: medicosys_request_form.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: on-demand audit export for SOC2 readiness (MedicoSys)

Hi Anoop — thanks for the clear scope and deadline. We can support an on-demand export for the date range you specified. A few clarifying items so we can proceed and meet the Aug 15 deadline: 

1) Delivery format: do you require raw NDJSON (recommended) or a summarized CSV for specific event types? NDJSON preserves event metadata and is preferred for audits.
2) User identifiers: do you want full usernames / email addresses included, or would you prefer pseudonymized IDs in the delivered files?
3) Delivery method: please confirm whether you'll provide an S3 bucket + role ARN for cross-account delivery or if you'd like a presigned PUT link. We recommend cross-account role for larger volumes (>50GB).
4) Chain-of-custody: we will produce a PGP-signed manifest with per-file sha256 and a delivery manifest. Do you need any additional notarization?

Operational note: standard on-demand export SLA for enterprise customers is 72 hours. We can prioritize this request to a 24–48 hour turnaround for customers with an expedited request (may incur fees). If you confirm the above items by EOD Aug 10, we'll target delivery within 48 hours of confirmation.

I'll loop in Karthik for export packaging and Marissa for compliance sign-off.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Lead — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: on-demand audit export for SOC2 readiness (MedicoSys)

Jordan / Marissa — technical plan below; copying the external contact so they can confirm format/delivery.

What we'll include (default export):
- admin.activity.ndjson: admin console actions (actor, action, object, timestamp, request_id)
- operator.trail.ndjson: operator session start/stop, exec commands, operator_id, session_id
- auth.events.ndjson: token lifecycle (issue, refresh, revoke), service account bindings
- infer.trace.metadata.ndjson: inference request headers (no raw prompt content by default unless requested)
- retention_metadata.json: retention policy applied and data deletion timestamps for requested range

Packaging and integrity:
- Files are exported in gzipped NDJSON, chunked by calendar day (e.g., admin.activity.2028-05-01.ndjson.gz).
- We will generate a manifest.jsonl (one JSON per line) that includes: filename, size_bytes, sha256, record_count, start_ts, end_ts.
- The manifest will be PGP-signed using our compliance signing key and accompanied by an HMAC of the manifest using a per-request secret.
- Transfer options: cross-account S3 role (preferred), presigned multipart PUT, or encrypted SCP to an approved host.

Sampling guidance for SOC2 evidence:
- For events within the last 90 days we recommend full delivery (100%).
- For historic windows beyond 90 days, we can provide a statistically representative sample: default is 10% random sampling with stratification by event type and day. Sampling parameters will be recorded in the manifest.
- If the auditor requires deterministic reproducibility, we'll provide the RNG seed and hashing keys used for sampling.

Redaction & PII handling:
- By default, we will include account identifiers and role names. IPs and raw prompt text are redacted unless explicitly requested and authorized.
- If MedicoSys requires IPs or prompt content, we need documented approval and will route the request through our Data Access Committee; this can add 48–72 hours.

Retention on our side: temporary staging for transfer will be encrypted and available for 7 days after successful delivery, then automatically deleted.

Attachments: sample_manifest.ndjson (format example).

Estimate: for a 3-month window and a mid-size account like MedicoSys, expect 10–120GB depending on request (we'll provide a pre-flight estimate after confirming event types).

If the external team confirms NDJSON + cross-account role and indicates whether they want IPs/prompts, we'll start the export prep.

— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Security Team <security@medicosys.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: on-demand audit export for SOC2 readiness (MedicoSys)

Hi Anoop / Priya — thanks for the request and for working through scope with Jordan and Karthik.

Compliance decision: we can produce the requested export with the following commitments: 
- Delivery SLA: 48 hours from confirmation (expedite applied for this request).
- Format: gzipped NDJSON, per-day chunking, PGP-signed manifest with sha256 checksums.
- Integrity: manifest HMAC shared out-of-band; we will provide sha256 hashes and a PGP-signed audit statement.
- Redaction: we will not include raw prompt content or client IP addresses unless MedicoSys provides documented authorization (email + signer).

Next steps for MedicoSys (please reply to this thread):
1) Confirm delivery method: cross-account S3 role ARN or presigned PUT.
2) Confirm whether usernames/emails can be included or if you require pseudonymization.
3) If IPs/prompts are required, provide written approval and expected contact for Data Access Committee review.

Once we receive confirmations, Karthik will kick off the export and provide a pre-flight estimate and the manifest example. We'll also open a secure ticket and share the upload instruction PDF.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
